fishing: WHEN: strong solunar window. PASSES-BEACH: snook, redfish, tarpon/sharks at Stump Pass/Manasota beaches. LEMON BAY: redfish schools, snook under docks, trout. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper, grunts, grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, cut bait, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis not observed statewide past week; no SWFL bloom.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (~20 CFU latest); Charlotte sites clear.
